source: Uso real v3 ronda 19 (r17 t1-c05 «va a llover mañana en valpo?» → weather_place_not_found; t2-c13 «¿qué tiempo va a hacer mañana en Valencia? ¿cojo paraguas?» → Valencia, Venezuela): a town said by its colloquial short form is looked up by its official name, and the words of a regional way of speaking point at the country when several towns of comparable size share the name (only a tie-break: the adapter never prefers a much smaller namesake). Only a whole place equal to a colloquial form is rewritten.
